body:
*Written by the Stylfixx team · Reviewed by Omar Sharieff, Director, Stylfixx Innovations Pvt. Ltd. · Last updated 13 November 2026*

**Quick answer:** clean the flat after your furniture has gone and before the handover inspection, ideally one or two days before the keys go back. Work top to bottom: fans and lights, walls and switchboards, windows and sliding tracks, kitchen and bathrooms, then floors. Photograph every room when you finish. A professional move-out deep clean of an empty 2BHK in Bangalore typically costs ₹4,500–₹6,500 and takes one day.

A clean, well-documented handover is the simplest way to avoid arguments over deductions from your security deposit. This checklist covers what to clean in each room, what landlords usually inspect, what counts as normal wear and tear, and how to choose between doing it yourself, an app-based service and a local cleaning company.

## When to book and how to plan

| When | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| 1–2 weeks before move-out | Read your rental agreement for cleaning, painting and handover clauses. Book cleaners for the day after the movers. |
| Move-out day | Movers take furniture out. Check inside wardrobes, lofts and the kitchen for anything left behind. |
| 1–2 days before handover | Deep clean the empty flat. Fix small damage, such as nail holes or a loose tap, separately. |
| Handover day | Walk through with the landlord or agent. Take dated photos and videos of every room, meter readings and keys returned. |

Cleaning an empty flat is faster and more thorough than cleaning around furniture, so time it for after the movers leave.

## Room-by-room move-out cleaning checklist

**Kitchen**

- Inside and outside of all cabinets, drawers and shelves; wipe out crumbs and oil marks.
- Countertop, sink and tap; descale the tap aerator.
- Wall tiles behind the hob, where oil splashes build up.
- Chimney exterior and filter (filters can be soaked and degreased); exhaust fan.
- Gas pipe and hob area; remove any stickers or tape.

**Bathrooms**

- Tiles and grout, including the corners near the floor.
- WC, washbasin, shower area and glass partition: remove hard-water stains and scale.
- Taps, shower head and fittings: descale.
- Mirror, cabinet and exhaust fan.
- Floor trap: clear hair and debris so water drains freely.

**Bedrooms and wardrobes**

- Inside every wardrobe and loft, including the top shelves.
- Wardrobe doors, handles and mirror.
- Walls: wipe off light marks; note anything that needs paint.

**Living and dining areas**

- Fan blades, light fittings and switchboards.
- Doors, door frames and handles.
- Skirting tiles along the floor.

**Windows, balconies and utility**

- Window glass, frames, grills and mesh.
- **Sliding tracks**, which collect a lot of dust and are often checked.
- Balcony floor, railing and drain outlet.
- Utility area: washing machine point, sink and taps.

**Floors (last)**

- Vacuum, then machine or hand scrub, paying attention to corners and under where furniture stood.

## What landlords usually check at handover

- Kitchen cabinets, the hob area and the chimney.
- Bathroom tiles, fittings and stains.
- Walls for marks, holes and damp patches.
- Fittings: taps, lights, fans, switches, door locks and keys.
- Windows, mesh and sliding tracks.
- Any appliances that came with the flat.

Compare what you see against your move-in photos or inventory, if you have them.

## Normal wear and tear or damage?

Under the Transfer of Property Act, a tenant has to return the property in the condition it was taken, allowing for normal use. Courts and tenancy guidelines generally treat routine repainting and normal ageing as the landlord's cost, while deductions should be itemised and backed by proof. Your rental agreement also matters, so read its clauses. This is general information, not legal advice.

| Usually normal wear and tear | Usually damage that can be deducted |
| --- | --- |
| Paint that has faded or has light scuffs | Large stains, crayon or heavy marks, many deep holes |
| Small nail or screw holes for pictures | Broken tiles, cracked glass or mirrors |
| Floor tiles dulled by normal use | Burns or chips on counters and floors |
| Fittings worn by normal use | Broken taps, switches or locks |
| Light dust in a lightly used flat | A flat left dirty, needing a full clean |

Cleaning removes dirt but not damage. Repair broken fittings and fill holes before handover; for paint touch-ups or a repaint, see [painting and waterproofing](/service/painting-and-water-proofing).

## Do it yourself, an app-based service or a local company?

| | Do it yourself | App-based platform, such as Urban Company | Local cleaning company |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cost | Lowest, but takes 1–2 days of your time | Fixed package prices shown in the app | Quoted after a call or visit; often similar to app prices |
| Booking | Your own time | Instant booking and online payment | Phone or WhatsApp; may need a few days' notice |
| Scope | What you can manage | Standard packages; add-ons for extras | Can usually be adjusted to the flat, for example extra tracks or chimney |
| Who comes | You | Assigned professionals, which can vary between bookings | Usually the company's own crew |
| Repairs | Separate | Separate services | Some companies, such as Stylfixx, also do repairs and painting |
| Best for | Small, lightly used flats | Quick bookings and standard jobs | Bigger flats, heavy dirt, or cleaning plus repairs before handover |

Whichever you choose, ask what exactly is included, whether the crew brings equipment and chemicals, and how long the job will take.

## Move-out deep cleaning cost in Bangalore (2026)

Typical Stylfixx prices for an empty or lightly furnished flat:

| Flat | Typical cost | Team and time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1BHK | ₹3,000 – ₹4,500 | 2–3 people, 4–5 hours |
| 2BHK | ₹4,500 – ₹6,500 | 3–4 people, 5–7 hours |
| 3BHK | ₹6,000 – ₹9,000 | 4–5 people, 6–8 hours |
| Villa or 4BHK | ₹9,000 – ₹15,000 | 5–6 people, about a day |

The cost goes up with heavy kitchen grease, hard-water scale in bathrooms and how long the flat has gone without a deep clean.

## Common mistakes

- Cleaning before the movers come, so dust and marks from moving furniture are left behind.
- Using acid on marble, granite or coloured grout, which etches the surface.
- Forgetting lofts, sliding tracks and the chimney filter.
- Not taking photos after cleaning.
- Leaving small repairs until the inspection.

title: Move-Out Cleaning Checklist for Rental Flats in Bangalore
description: Room-by-room move-out cleaning checklist for rental flats in Bangalore: what landlords check, wear and tear vs damage, costs, and app vs local cleaners.

faqs.question: When should I deep clean a rental flat before moving out?
faqs.answer: After the movers have taken the furniture out and before the handover inspection, ideally one or two days before you return the keys.

faqs.question: How much does move-out cleaning cost in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: In 2026, a professional deep clean of an empty flat in Bangalore typically costs ₹3,000 to ₹4,500 for a 1BHK, ₹4,500 to ₹6,500 for a 2BHK and ₹6,000 to ₹9,000 for a 3BHK.

faqs.question: Can a landlord deduct repainting costs from my deposit?
faqs.answer: Routine repainting and faded paint are generally treated as normal wear and tear, which is the landlord's cost, while damage beyond normal use can be deducted with proof. Check your rental agreement and ask for an itemised breakdown of any deduction.

faqs.question: What do landlords check at the move-out inspection?
faqs.answer: Usually kitchen cabinets and the chimney, bathroom tiles and fittings, walls, fans, lights, switches, locks, windows, mesh and sliding tracks, compared with the condition at move-in.

faqs.question: Is an app-based cleaning service better than a local company?
faqs.answer: App-based platforms are quick to book with fixed packages. Local companies can adjust the scope to your flat and sometimes handle repairs and painting too. Compare what each includes for your flat size.

faqs.question: Should I take photos after cleaning?
faqs.answer: Yes. Take dated photos or a video of every room, the meter readings and the keys returned, so you have a record of the handover condition.
